technology_name: Biodegradable Lignocellulose Fibre-Based Mulching Mats and Sheets
institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
problem_solved: Weed growth, soil moisture loss, soil erosion, and dependence on non-biodegradable mulching materials
description: These biodegradable mulching mats and sheets are produced from lignocellulosic fibres and are designed for agricultural use. The materials help reduce evaporation, support drip irrigation, suppress weed growth, and improve soil conditions. They offer an alternative to plastic-based mulching materials while supporting crop growth and field management practices.
applications:
Horticulture and commercial crop cultivation enterprises
Organic farming and sustainable agriculture initiatives
Nursery, landscaping, and plantation management sectors
Agricultural input and biodegradable agri-material manufacturers
Government agriculture departments and soil conservation programs
secondary_sector: Climate & Sustainability, Water, Environment & Waste Management, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
